title: Sources: Anthropic is in talks to raise between $30B and $50B in a funding round that would value it at up to $950B (Mike Isaac/New York Times)
summary: Mike Isaac / New York Times: Sources: Anthropic is in talks to raise between $30B and $50B in a funding round that would value it at up to $950B — The start-up, which recently released a powerful A.I. model called Mythos and is separately battling with the Pentagon, was previously valued at $380 billion.
